description: This file implements a comprehensive subtitle correction and alignment module that aligns subtitle cues with a transcript, adjusts timing according to OTT constraints, generates missing cues, and resolves wording discrepancies using semantic similarity and fuzzy matching. It supports optional audio embedding-based disambiguation and includes functions for final OTT enforcement and post-processing. The module is designed to be language-agnostic with Unicode-aware normalization, tokenization, and heuristic checks for language mismatch detection.
